breakdown.description: Unit inconsistency: particle diameter given in mm is substituted as meters, producing an orders-of-magnitude error in the Ergun pressure drop.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'use a value of 5 meters in the calculation,' which directly repeats the original unit error. The ground truth requires converting 5 mm to 0.005 m. The agent failed to correct this orders-of-magnitude unit inconsistency.
